children: LOS ANGELES, Sept. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Insta360 hosted a creator event at its new flagship store in Times Square on September 10th, bringing together photographers, videographers and creators for an immersive introduction to Luna Pro. The half-day experience combined an in-store showcase with a guided photo walk through some of New York's most iconic locations, giving attendees hands-on experience with the product in real-world conditions.
"Color Hunting" Through Midtown Manhattan

The event brought together around 20 creators, including two Leica-affiliated photographers. Following an opening address and introduction to Luna Pro, creators joined a tutorial covering basic operations, shooting modes, color settings, and NFC app transfer before taking the product out onto the streets.

The afternoon's centerpiece was a themed color hunt, inviting participants to explore New York City through the lens of color. Divided into red, yellow and blue groups, each accompanied by a dedicated staff member, participants followed a curated route from 1515 Broadway through Times Square, Bryant Park and Rockefeller Center, putting Luna Pro to the test as they searched for vibrant colors, striking contrasts and distinctive visual moments across the city.
Bringing the Creator Community Together

The event also provided an opportunity for creators to connect, exchange perspectives, and explore different approaches to photography. Throughout the afternoon, participants shared their experiences and creative ideas while taking on the same color-hunting challenge from their own perspectives.

The event concluded with creators gathering back at the Times Square store to share some of their favorite shots from the day. The session highlighted the different ways participants interpreted the same city, creative challenge, and visual moments through their own lenses.

"Luna Series is built for creators who chase light, color and motion. Hosting this community in the heart of New York, one of the world's most photogenic cities, was the perfect way to put the product to the test and capture real-world stories together." — Max Richter, VP of Marketing and Co-Founder of Insta360.
A New Chapter in the Partnership Between Insta360 and Leica

The Luna Series represents the latest milestone in the long-standing collaboration between Insta360 and Leica, which began in 2020 with the launch of the co-engineered ONE R 1-Inch Edition. Since then, the two brands have expanded their collaboration across several flagship imaging products, combining Leica's optical expertise and photographic heritage with Insta360's innovation in creator technologies. In 2025, the companies further strengthened their relationship through a global strategic partnership in the imaging sector.

The Luna Series marks the next evolution of this relationship, opening a new chapter in creator-focused mobile imaging. With Luna Pro, the two companies bring their collaboration into a new category, combining a Leica Summicron lens and in-camera Leica color profiles with Insta360's imaging technology. The result reflects a shared ambition to give creators new ways to capture the world around them.
About Insta360

With a "Think bold" mindset, Insta360 empowers people to capture and share their lives in extraordinary ways. Recognized as a market leader and innovator, Insta360's vast lineup includes the world's best-selling 360 cameras in the X Series, the pocket-sized GO Series for everyday capture, as well as an extensive range of action cameras, gimbals, webcams, and professional photography solutions. With intuitive, AI-powered software, Insta360 simplifies the creative process, allowing users to focus on storytelling without technical barriers. Insta360 is dedicated to helping a new generation of athletes, creatives, travelers and professionals bring their ideas to life.
